mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment below 4% signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and equity prices.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are both high, it indicates a tightening cycle, negatively impacting equity returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS in a tightening cycle leads to lower equity returns as borrowing costs increase.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Stable CPI indicates controlled inflation, leading to positive equity returns as investor confidence grows.
failure_condition: CPI stable but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 indicates supply constraints, leading to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment and retail sales indicates strong demand, boosting equity prices.
failure_condition: PAYEMS and RSAFS growth but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts in an expansion regime signals economic growth, leading to positive equity returns.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1200 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
